test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Four publications have been listed, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
• Hindustan Times, The Indian Express, and The Hindu are newspapers, and India Today is a magazine.
 
• So India Today is different from others.

Hence, **"India Today"** is the correct answer.
